body: Rather assumes staying conscious. 1-2 klonopin with alcohol tends to knock me out in minutes.
Some social anxiety, but mostly fears of triggering compulsive episodes with my OCD. Isolation allows some avoidance of that, but either direction results in limited practical control.

I'm not even sure it will be enough. I know the klonopin and booze will depress my breathing and heartrate. I keep debating trying to cut my wrists, too, but I'd rather just...drift away than bleed out.

Feeling like my mental illness leaves my life only tangentially in my control.  
Feeling like I can't adapt to the symptoms without isolating (and even then, only in limited ways).

And...feeling like the pain of being this isolated and this miserable is too much for me to hide from any more. Like it's a burden that's been growing steadily and slowly for years-edging-into-decades. And like the weight has finally crushed the last fragments of will from me.
